occupation: Airline Pilots, Copilots, and Flight Engineers
job_summary: Operate and coordinate airline flights, including route planning, aircraft system monitoring, communication with ground control and crew members, aircraft inspection and maintenance activities, and leadership during flight operations and emergencies.

hard_gates.requirement: Previous employment as an airline pilot, copilot, or flight engineer
hard_gates.source_support: The source job description explicitly requires previous employment as an airline pilot, copilot, or flight engineer for a minimum of 3 years.

hard_gates.requirement: Prior working experience as a ship or boat captain or operator
hard_gates.source_support: The source job description explicitly requires prior working experience as a ship or boat captain or operator for a minimum of 3 years.

soft_criteria.criterion: Navigation and route-selection ability, including choosing appropriate routes, altitudes, or speeds
soft_criteria.why_relevant: The job description requires exceptional navigation skills, and O*NET lists choosing routes, altitudes, and speeds and steering aircraft along planned routes as core tasks.

soft_criteria.criterion: Leadership and coordination of flight crews and other personnel
soft_criteria.why_relevant: The job description requires leadership and management skills, while O*NET identifies coordination and describes directing aircraft crew activities as part of the occupation.

soft_criteria.criterion: Mechanical knowledge and ability to identify or respond to aircraft equipment problems
soft_criteria.why_relevant: The job description requires solid mechanical knowledge, and O*NET identifies Mechanical knowledge and tasks involving aircraft inspection, malfunction reporting, and maintenance.

soft_criteria.criterion: Clear communication and information sharing with crew members, ground control, and other relevant personnel
soft_criteria.why_relevant: The job description requires outstanding communication skills, and O*NET lists communicating with supervisors, peers, and subordinates as well as coordinating vehicle movement and flight control activities.

soft_profile.candidate_evidence: Demonstrates strong ability to select and follow appropriate transportation routes and consider operating conditions.
Demonstrates moderate ability to coordinate activities and lead other personnel.
Demonstrates limited mechanical knowledge and limited evidence of responding to aircraft equipment problems.
Demonstrates clear communication with crew members and other personnel involved in transportation operations.
